import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { normalizeEmail } from "@/lib/identity/normalize-email"

export function keyFor(rawEmail: string) {
    return normalizeEmail(rawEmail)
}

export async function addPhantom(email: string, name: string) {
    return db.user.create({ data: { email, name, roles: "policyholder" } })
}
